source: Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers (OPMCM)
title: Rasuwa Flood Rescue Portal (OPMCM)
body: Official Government of Nepal portal for the 2026 Bhote Koshi–Trishuli / Rasuwa flood response. Families can search missing and found reports, request help, browse help requests, and open emergency contacts. Run by the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers. This site links to the portal; we do not copy names or case details.
